A.title: Large Language Models are Fixated by Red Herrings: Exploring Creative Problem Solving and Einstellung Effect with the OnlyConnect Wall Dataset
A.venue: NeurIPS 2023 Track on Datasets and Benchmarks

E.headline: GPT-4 outperformed other tested language models but remained far below human performance; reducing red herrings improved grouping results.

G.notes: Human grouping results are episode-level contestant performance, while model results are aggregated over 494 test walls; the paper gives no human participant count or inferential model–human test. The red-herring ablations alter task difficulty and composition, so they do not isolate a controlled human-style fixation effect.
